mechanics.body_shape: SUB ESP,0x24 / PUSH ESI / MOV ESI,ECX, then a straight-line guarded pipeline of five early exits (all JZ to 0x00c33681 except the child test's JZ to 0x00c33680), then a conditional release guarded by a signed range test, then POP EDI / POP ESI / ADD ESP,0x24 / RET. No indirect transfer, no loop, no switch, and no tail call (tail_call.present false, after_frame_setup false).
mechanics.frame_resolution: FR = entry_ESP-0x24, the first byte the SUB creates. PUSH ESI puts the saved ESI at FR-0x04, so ESP is FR at the start of the body. The mid-body PUSH EDI at 0x00c335ed is NOT undone until 0x00c33680, so from that instruction to the epilogue ESP is entry_ESP-0x2c. Every [esp+disp] in the body follows from those two facts plus the two epilogue requirements: the exit at 0x00c33681 needs ESP == entry_ESP-0x28 there and the exit at 0x00c33680 needs ESP == entry_ESP-0x2c there. The machine parse agrees the body is fully resolved (esp_unresolved false, local_extent 0) and it abstained only on the linear walk, because the walk is not one path.

frame_layout.0x04 (entry_ESP-0x20): 0x00c3363e LEA edx,[esp+0x10] with ESP=entry_ESP-0x30: the out-parameter 0x00e5c780 writes and this body reads back at 0x00c33653

mechanics.record_displacement: The record 0x00bb9b80 returns is read at +0x00, +0x04 and +0x08 (0x00c335b1/b3/b6), one level of indirection. Its shape is corroborated from the other side by 0x00bb9b90, the four-instruction setter next door, which writes the same three words at its receiver's +0x74/+0x78/+0x7c. The +0x00 word is tested, never stored; +0x04 and +0x08 are stored into the block at 0x0c and 0x10.
mechanics.control_flow: Five JZ to 0x00c33681 (handle sentinel at 0x00c3358f, first lookup null at 0x00c335a4, record word 0 zero at 0x00c335c3, re-read handle sentinel at 0x00c335d2, second lookup null at 0x00c335e7) and one JZ to 0x00c33680 (child null at 0x00c335f9). The tail is JLE 0x00c33680 (0x00c33671, SIGNED) then TEST EAX,EAX / JZ 0x00c33680 (0x00c33675): the range test first, the null test second, so the two are not interchangeable. Every branch target lies inside the body span, so the branch graph is closed inside it.
mechanics.dispatch_structure: No dispatch. Ten direct transfers, all CALL, to ten distinct addresses, each in the xref export as a direct-call edge; the export's callee set and the listing's transfer set are identical.
mechanics.miss_path: Every miss returns without writing anything: the sentinel exits before the getter, the two null-lookup exits and the null-child exit return before the colour call, and the record-word-0 exit returns after the two stored words are in the frame but before the colour callee is given the block. Only the range/null guard on the released pointer can end the body after the colour call, and it ends it by skipping the release.
mechanics.globals: Two .rdata words and nothing else: 0x1667bac, loaded once at 0x00c3360b and stored twice (0x00c33617 into element 1, 0x00c3361b into element 2), and 0x1667bae, stored once at 0x00c3361f into element 3. Both addresses are inside .rdata (VMA 0x013cc000..0x0152b5ae). No other data-segment address appears in the body. The GLOBALS dimension cannot adjudicate a store: the xref export carries no data-reference edge type at all, so there is no second machine side to corroborate the read/write mode, and the store is in the listing, so omitting it would falsify the body.
mechanics.direct_call_1: 0x00b3d2a0, six bytes, MOV EAX,ds:0x167eae4 ; RET. No argument, no receiver, and it pops nothing -- which is why the handle pushed at 0x00c33595 is still on the stack when 0x00ba6d80 is entered and is taken there as [esp+0x4].
mechanics.layout_derivation: The frame layout is derived from the epilogue, not guessed, and it is what makes the argument order of 0x00e5c780 and the base of the twelve-byte block decidable. The four-word block occupies the top sixteen bytes of the 0x24-byte frame exactly, and the five dwords below it are the key, the out-parameter and the twelve-byte block, with no slack and no overlap -- which is what makes the frame internally consistent rather than merely plausible.

return_semantics.value: Nothing. EAX at the single RET is path-dependent and never a value: the two null-lookup results and the null-child result (0), record word 2, the handle sentinel, the found node's first word, 0, and the begin pointer. Ghidra's decompilation of this VA returns void on every path.
return_semantics.ownership: Nothing is returned, so nothing is owned. The two callees whose return values the body ignores (0x00c32cd0 and 0x00f47380) are declared discarded in the source, and the test's observers return poison pointers to prove both discards are real. The one callee return the body DOES read is 0x00e5c780's, and it is read as an address, not as a node.
return_semantics.lifetime: Not applicable. The model test's observer fixtures outlive every run and each run is self-contained; nothing in this package owns memory on the original's behalf, and the release at 0x00f47380 is modelled, not performed.

unresolved_questions: RETURN SEMANTICS is a WARN by construction, and this is a choice rather than an oversight. abi.return_semantics is the machine phrase unclassified_in_EAX and abi_derived.return.void_possible is false, so no C++ return type can satisfy the canonical claim. The package declares void, because the listing produces nothing coherent in EAX on any of its eight exits and Ghidra's decompilation returns void throughout, and it records the disagreement here instead of declaring a typedef named after the phrase. If the integrator would rather see a non-void declaration, the only listing-true candidate is a 32-bit value, and no evidence in this repository picks which.

The value at FR+0x14 (entry_ESP-0x10) is UNKNOWN and is read by the body. 0x00c33665 loads it, the null test at 0x00c33675 tests it and 0x00c33677 pushes it, but nothing in the body writes it and neither callee that receives the block's address is given its address. 0x004da330 demonstrably only reads the block; 0x00b6f380 was not analysed deeply enough to exclude a write, so that half remains open. The model therefore reads an injectable one-word residue and asserts only the READ. Whether the original source had a four-element block whose first element it forgot to initialise, or a callee that fills it, cannot be settled from this listing.

The four-word block's element 0 and the release range interact in a way this listing cannot explain: the range is (element 2 - element 0) & 0xfffffffe, i.e. it starts at an element the body never wrote and ends two elements into a three-element initialisation. The guard reads as the standard 'more than one element' idiom for a two-byte element type, which does not match four-byte pointers. The reconstruction reproduces the arithmetic exactly and asserts nothing about what the range means.

Whether 0x00e5c780 actually finds key 2 in the map at receiver+0x14 is not claimed. The body passes the key and dereferences the result with NO null test -- 0x00c33653 is `MOV EAX,[EAX]` straight after the call -- so on the original a failed search would fault if the callee wrote a null. The model test cannot drive that case without invoking undefined behaviour, so it is documented as not asserted rather than tested.

The twelve-byte block's MEANING is not claimed. 0x00c32cd0 writes three floats into it and this body reads none of them back; the model test proves the INDEPENDENCE (the payload does not change the trace) but says nothing about what the values are.

The receiver at 0x0c, 0x14 and 0x3c is opaque, so the sizes of the map, the sync target and the text sink are unknown; the map's own layout is available in reconstruction/metadata/pkg20-gameglobal/00e5c780.json but its offset inside THIS receiver is not, and no member of this receiver is named anywhere in the package.

__thiscall versus __fastcall is not decidable here: the body has no ordinary stack argument, and on x86-32 the two are identical at the boundary. The derived record picks __thiscall with confidence INFERRED and corroboration not_available. __thiscall is declared because every inner call is a callee-cleaned ECX-receiver call, which is a class-method shape, but a fastcall declaration would be byte-identical.

The identity of the .rdata words 0x1667bac and 0x1667bae is unknown. They are stored, in that order, into block elements 1, 2 and 3, and nothing in this body or in any callee it calls reads them back. They are most likely string or asset-table addresses, but no record in this repository maps either address to a name, so none is invented.

The GLOBALS dimension cannot pass for this target and no source change can fix it: the body stores a .rdata address and the xref export carries no data-reference edge type to corroborate the mode. The store is kept because it is in the listing.

validation.compile_gate: Builds clean under -m32 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror, and the same pair builds and passes at -O2. The header compiles alone with -c. Nothing in the span reads a frame byte that the body has not already written, which is what the -O2 pass confirms.
validation.model_test: seventeen cases, all ten callees as observers, and three whole mutant bodies. The cases are: sentinel exits before any call; a handle of 0 is a live value; the lookup's argument and receiver; the handle is read twice (an observer rewrites receiver+0xb0 during the first lookup and the re-read must see it); the second lookup uses the re-read value; the three null gates; the gate is the record's first word and is a value, not a pointer (driven with a pointer-looking 0xdeadbee0); the twelve-byte block and its base, identified by content; the four-word block is stored before either consumer samples it; the three interior offsets are addresses, not the decoy words stored there; the map key slot holds 2 at the moment of the call and the out-parameter is the first stack word; the map result is dereferenced exactly once; the address the callee RETURNS is the one that is read (the only case that can separate that from the out-slot, since the two are otherwise the same address); the range guard over ten scenarios (8, 5, 4 released; 3, 2, 1, 0, above-end, large-unsigned, null not released); the end of the range is element 2; the receiver and a canary past it are never written; and the colour payload does not change the trace. The three mutants -- a two-level map read, an unsigned range compare with no AND, and the lookup's two arguments swapped -- are caught by 5, 17 and 19 of those checks respectively, and the counts are printed by the run.

mutation_checking.mutant_two_level_map_read: 5 checks fail. The body dereferences the found node twice instead of once.
mutation_checking.mutant_unsigned_range: 17 checks fail. The AND is dropped and the range compare is unsigned, so a begin above end is released.
mutation_checking.mutant_lookup_argument_order: 19 checks fail. The getter's return is the lookup's argument and the handle is its receiver.

validation.wpedantic_note: The test also caught a real defect in this package's own first draft: the range ends were written as byte_at(&frame, slot) -- the ADDRESS of the slot -- instead of the word stored in it, which the ten range scenarios exposed immediately. The committed body loads the words, as 0x00c33661 and 0x00c33665 do.

expected.ABI: PASS -- the span names SW2_00C33580_THISCALL, which the package header defines as __thiscall, and the derived conventions record has confidence INFERRED (neither unknown nor approximation) with no unresolved ABI conflict.
expected.CALLS: PASS -- the ten address-named callees in the span are exactly the listing's ten direct transfer targets and the xref export's ten callees; no other call is named.
expected.GLOBALS: WARN -- the listing names two .rdata addresses (0x1667bac, 0x1667bae) and the xref export carries no data-reference edge type, so there is nothing to corroborate the store's mode against. EXPECTED, and unfixable in the source: the store is in the listing.
expected.FIELDS/OFFSETS: PASS on the grounded arm -- the span declares no member and no displacement literal (the machine receiver record is bounds_only, so no member is named), the complete listing names no displacement through ECX, and the alias-aware scan in evidence_fields accounts for the four receiver-relative displacements the body reaches through the ESI alias. What the record states is where the body was seen reaching, not which member is which, so no field is identified by name.
expected.CONSTANTS: PASS -- the span's only hexadecimal literal is 0xfffffffe (AND EDX,0xfffffffe at 0x00c3366b), it is in the listing, and the parse record consumed all 79 instructions with none unparsed and none degraded. Every other constant in the package is a named constexpr in the header, so it is outside the span and is checked by the model test instead.
expected.CONTROL FLOW: PASS -- all seven conditional branch targets lie inside 0x00c33580..0x00c33685, so the branch graph closes inside the recovered span.
expected.VIRTUAL DISPATCH: PASS -- no register- or memory-operand transfer in the 79 instructions, the dispatch record counts 0, and the span declares no slot boundary.
expected.RETURN SEMANTICS: WARN -- the canonical claim is the machine phrase unclassified_in_EAX and the source declares void. EXPECTED: evidence_returns defers whenever a canonical claim exists, so no declared return type can move this dimension.
expected.EVIDENCE COVERAGE: WARN -- this pack reports unavailable/MISSING for callees_dependencies, callers_dependencies, contradictions, external_callees, globals, runtime, types and vtables.
